unlisted_practices: Agent-based architecture (ReAct agent) using specialized retrieval tools over curated clinical vector stores to improve oncology answer accuracy
Hybrid search strategy with summarized content to reduce context fragmentation

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates a novel agent-based architecture (GeneSilico Copilot) using tool use and retrieval-augmented generation for precision oncology QA on breast cancer cases. This is system/model architecture development rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
